ios.desc:
The Opal Travel app is the official Transport for NSW app to help you get around in NSW Australia. You can plan and save your trip, check travel activities and fares, top up Opal card and more, all in one place. Download the FREE Opal Travel app now.
 
Key features:
- Manage and top up Opal card on the go:  Register your Opal card to check your balance, top up or set up auto top-up.
- Track Opal and Contactless payment activities: Review your Opal and contactless payment travel history and fares.
- Simple trip planning: Plan your trip via public transport, cycling, walking, or driving, set your favourite trips and locations, and check public transport fares.
- Check departure times at a glance: Check public transport departure times for train, metro, bus, light rail and ferry services.
- Get live trip update:  Receive service update, disruption and on-the-go hop off alerts for your trip.
 
For more info, visit https://transportnsw.info/apps/opal-travel
 
By installing Opal Travel you acknowledge and accept the Opal Travel app Terms of Use and agree to receive those Terms of Use and any amendments electronically via the Apple App Store. You acknowledge that Transport for NSW will not send you a paper copy.

This application is not optimised for iPad's larger screen, which may cause visual or layout issues. For the best experience, please use an iPhone device.
